title: Unshifted Koszul restriction vanishes
statement: For a commutative ring A and a finite family f, the derived open restriction to the union of the basic opens of the sheafified Koszul complex is zero.

source.place: Tag 09IR and More on Algebra, Tag 0663

proof.text: In each degree, apply basic-open Koszul exactness to every generator and glue exactness over their union U. This gives an acyclic complex after termwise restriction.

The zero map from the zero complex to the acyclic restricted complex is a quasi-isomorphism degreewise. Derived localization inverts it; transport the zero-object property along its resulting isomorphism, then along mapDerivedCategoryFactors to identify termwise restriction followed by localization with derived restriction of the original localization.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09IR, first displayed equality; local contraction Tag 0663; stalkwise exactness Tag 01AG

lean.statement:
theorem isZero_restrict_koszul_base
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : U = ⨆ i : Fin r, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))))
